['S\u00fcwag Vertrieb AG & Co. KG '].company_description: Süwag Vertrieb AG & Co. KG operates in the energy sector, focusing on the generation, distribution, and sale of electricity, gas, heat, and water. The company is involved in the operation of wind farms and the provision of energy-related services.

['DB Netz AG '].company_description: DB Netz AG is a major subsidiary of Deutsche Bahn that owns and operates a majority of the German railway system. It is one of the largest railway infrastructure managers by length and transport volume of its network. The company is profitable from route fees but receives extensive public funding for maintaining, developing, and extending the network of European and federal transportation routes. It is also overseen by the Federal Network Agency and is set to merge with DB Station&Service to form DB InfraGO in 2024.
